#pragma once
// Centered Cartesian B flux through one opposing face pair, written as
// neighbor-minus-cell differences to annihilate identical stored B exactly.
#ifdef __CUDACC__
#define JAN_FN __host__ __device__ inline
#else
#define JAN_FN inline
#endif
template<class R> JAN_FN R janhunen_pair_flux(const R*bc,const R*bm,const R*bp,const R*nl,R al,const R*nh,R ah){
 R low=R(0),high=R(0);for(int v=0;v<3;++v){low+=R(.5)*(bm[v]-bc[v])*nl[v]*al;high+=R(.5)*(bp[v]-bc[v])*nh[v]*ah;}return high-low;
}
#undef JAN_FN
